description: phone = Host-only: approve a DM, forged DM ops refused, Host sees no DM material, Host app restart resumes with roles intact
steps: STEP: clean slate for live-session test data (test build fixture)
STEP: F-G: start hosting as HOST ONLY with manual DM approval
CHECK ok: a Host-only device is routed to the Host screen
STEP: a DM and two players dial the phone over TCP
CHECK ok: the DM holds no capability until the Host approves
CHECK ok: the phone Host refuses a DM op from an unapproved participant
STEP: the phone user approves the DM
CHECK ok: after approval the DM holds the dm capability and NOT host
CHECK ok: the DM did not gain the host capability
STEP: DM runs the table through the phone Host: campaign, encounter, secret effect, change request
CHECK ok: the phone Host applied every DM op
CHECK ok: the secret effect identity never crossed the phone Host to the player
STEP: a Player forges a DM op against the phone Host
CHECK ok: the phone Host refuses a DM op from a Player over the real network
STEP: the Host screen shows sessions and roles but NO DM material
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "Bridge Ambush"
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "Hidden Curse"
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "Blessing"
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "Exhaustion Increase"
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "automation fixture"
CHECK ok: Host screen does not show "Bandit"
CHECK ok: a Host-only device has no DM screen entry
CHECK ok: a Host-only device has no Player screen entry
STEP: Host app restart: kill the app, relaunch, resume the hosted session
CHECK ok: the DM kept its role across a Host restart (token + registry persisted)
CHECK ok: the live state (accepted request) survived the Host restart
CHECK ok: effects survived the Host restart exactly once
STEP: AH: end the session from the phone
